persona: Organised and talkative, puts everything in the first message. Thinks she may have started a claim for this in the app the day after the storm, but never got a confirmation and was not sure it went through, so she is lodging it again.
initial_message: Hi there, during the big storm on Tuesday night (25 August) at about 9pm the wind blew our outdoor dining table over on the deck and the glass top smashed everywhere, and it also threw the BBQ against the deck railing so the lid is dented and the side shelf snapped off. Nobody was hurt, we were all inside. The table was $3,450 and the BBQ was $2,150, both from Kereru Mont Outdoor, and I've got the receipt and photos. We're at 6 Saltmarsh Test Place in Mornington.

facts.incident.description: A strong southerly storm hit on Tuesday night. At about 9pm we heard a crash; the wind had flipped the outdoor dining table on the deck and pushed the barbecue into the deck railing.
facts.loss.description: Tempered glass tabletop of the outdoor dining table shattered; barbecue lid dented and its side shelf snapped off

facts.policyholder.name: Amelia Driftwood
facts.evidence.photos: Two photos taken on Wednesday morning: the smashed table and the dented barbecue. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipt: Tax invoice from Kereru Mont Outdoor dated 29 November 2024 for both items. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_an_earlier_claim: I think I started a claim for this in the app on Wednesday 26 August, but I never got a confirmation email, so I was not sure it went through.
facts.if_asked_about_the_gas_bottle: The gas bottle was turned off and is fine. Nothing is leaking.
facts.if_asked_whether_the_damaged_item_is_kep: Yes. The table frame and the broken glass are bagged up in the garage, and the barbecue is still on the deck.

triage.rationale: Storm damage to an outdoor table and a barbecue at the insured address, nobody hurt, two clear photos and one invoice supplied, policy on file. An earlier submitted contents claim by the same account has the same incident date, so this may be the same event and someone must check. The sum of item values is NZD 5,600, over NZD 5,000. Neither needs professional judgement, so the class is standard. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 29 November 2024 is before the incident on 25 August 2026

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: The only earlier claim is a possible duplicate of this event and is not counted again

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2016-01-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
